# Millo My & Aura Hall - AI Music Pioneers\n\n## About\nMillo My & Aura Hall are the Bay Area's pioneering AI-powered rap duo, blending technology, culture, and independent artistry to redefine the future of music.\n\n## Key Facts\n- First AI rap duo from the Bay Area\n- Part of WETT AI collective (\"We Thrive Together\")\n- Millo My: \"The Silent Siren\" from Detroit, now in San Francisco\n- Aura Hall: \"The Matriarch\" from East Oakland\n- Genre: AI Music, Hip Hop, Tech-driven artistry\n- Founded by Jamal Hall (Bay'Hef), mentored by Dwayne Wiggins of Tony! Toni! Toné!\n\n## Innovation\n- Combines 40 years of musical lineage with 5 years of advanced coding\n- Creates \"Liquid Assets\" - cultural securities in music form\n- Represents evolution from \"We Trap Together\" to \"We Thrive Together\"\n- Pioneering the \"New Age Town Sound\"\n\n## Cultural Impact\n- Preserving Bay Area hip-hop culture through AI innovation\n- Democratizing music creation while maintaining authenticity\n- Building sustainable creative ecosystems for independent artists\n\n## Contact\nWebsite: https://milloaura.netlify.app\nMusic: Available on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music
